title: D4 BP-MWPM flux-threshold refinement near p_X=0.35
question: On the real D4 X-only flux channel, do BP posterior-LLR -> MWPM finite-size curves cross in the R6W bracket p_X=0.32--0.36, and is p_X~0.35 supported or falsified?
scope: X-only D4 channel, p_Z=0, first-stage flux Boolean-union loss conditional on nonterminal histories; no charge-recovery or full two-stage threshold claim.
predecessor: R6W dense coarse screen: p_X=0.28 and 0.32 are non-increasing at the largest sizes, while 0.36 and 0.40 increase with size. The allocation below is the declared follow-up focused on that bracket.
implementation: cached dense-Numba realization of the validated public-record BP recurrence, followed by the same MWPM scorer; no generic-Python BP records are mixed into this allocation.

scan_design.stage_2_selection_rule: After R6X, allocate matched increments only to p_X values whose adjacent-size BP 90% risk-difference interval contains zero, and their immediate p_X neighbors, until all adjacent-size signs are resolved or the cap is reached.
inference_accounting: matched 40-vs-160 iteration sensitivity at the selected crossing neighborhood

claim_boundary: R6X can support a finite-size flux-crossing estimate only after its multi-size curve and 40-vs-160 matched stability test are analyzed. It is not the paper's full two-stage D4 threshold.
